provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: reps bookkeeping (L42-L43) assigns the host's count to every component sharing that frequency; whether Num_Coherent counts components or frequencies is ambiguous (coherent_idx counts entries with reps>1, L44-L45), so the loop may overshoot the requested percentage.
audit_member_text: Counting can overshoot or misrepresent the target across L42-L45: reps is propagated to every frequency equal to a host, and coherent_idx counts both hosts and all guests with reps>1. The while condition only requires the count to reach/exceed Num_Coherent, not equal it.

base_member_text: Hmo_output (L87) is computed as a check but never compared or returned.
audit_member_text: The claimed output-height check at L86-L87 only computes Hmo_output and never compares it with Hmo or raises a diagnostic, so failed energy calibration is not detected.

base_member_text: Host selection maps each guest to the nearest host frequency ABOVE it (negative differences set to inf, L35-L37); if a guest exceeds all hosts, min of all-inf gives index 1 — behavior in that edge case is questionable and unguarded.
audit_member_text: Invalid-host fallback at L35-L39: when a guest frequency exceeds every host, all freq_diff entries become Inf, yet min selects the first host and the guest is moved to a lower frequency despite the preceding exclusion rule. An empty host_freqs vector is likewise unhandled.

base_member_text: All spectral parameters come from load inputs.mat (L5) — Coherent_Percentage, mcomponent, mfreq, depth, g, fp, gamma_spec, sigma_theta, theta_mean, Hmo are never defined in this file, so the function's behavior is opaque without that mat-file (produced by a sibling script not in this file).
The input arguments idx_theta and freq_in vs the loaded mfreq/mcomponent overlap in role; idx_theta is never used in the function body.
audit_member_text: Function-interface violation at L1-L5: load inputs.mat injects hidden dependencies (including Coherent_Percentage, mcomponent, mfreq, depth, g, fp, gamma_spec, sigma_theta, theta_mean, and Hmo) directly into the local workspace and can overwrite same-named explicit inputs. The declared idx_theta input is never used anywhere.

base_member_text: The wrapped-normal series truncation N_spec=20/sigma_theta (L72) is not an integer in general; MATLAB's colon operator truncates implicitly.
audit_member_text: Singularity checks are absent across L53-L85: nonpositive frequency/fp, nonpositive depth/g, zero sigma_theta, zero Energy_total, zero sum(AG.*EnergyBin), or zero freq_resolution can create Inf/NaN or division by zero. N_spec at L72 is also not forced to an integer before use as a loop bound.

base_member_text: The while loop can exhaust freqs_pool before reaching Num_Coherent if the count logic stalls; no guard exists (L27-L46).
audit_member_text: Pool-exhaustion/range defect across L17 and L27-L33: Num_Coherent is not bounded by the achievable pool/count. If the target cannot be reached, mfreq_temp becomes zero and guest_idx becomes zero, making freqs_pool(0) invalid; ceil(rand*mfreq_temp) can also produce zero if rand returns exactly zero.

base_member_text: The comment '% 79.6287' (L70) is an unexplained magic number left in the code.

audit_member_text: Shape/interface assumptions: reps is sized from loaded mfreq at L21 while indexing uses freq_in/host indices; theta(kf), EnergyBin, and AG assume all loaded/input lengths and orientations agree, without validation.
